issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other: Sewer 50,182.55, Water 56,598.68, Sanitation 21,098.23
issues.issue: These are the utility funds' only receipts besides the federal grant and the 3,624.49 property tax, so they are very likely user charges (Sanitation 21,098.23 is all of that fund's revenue). The form never says so, and Local Receipts is a context label, so the line stays other until the context check decides it
